sara_csharp_orchestrator.description: C# SARA acts as the orchestrator and fallback generative AI for WFH setup. All actions, plugins, and UI requests are routed through SARA's CONTROL logic. NBS (memory/state) is managed by SARA. Generative AI (LLM) is available for tasks, summaries, and fallback reasoning.

pillar_activation.handoff_logic: When pillar is ready, route relevant actions to it; fallback to SARA if offline.

fsm_pillar_map.description: FSM routing and pillar state transitions for orchestrator automation, derived from shunt_map_descriptor.updated.json.

fallback_and_recovery.pillar_failure: SARA resumes orchestrator/AI duties for that pillar until restored

plugin_management.plugin_routing: All plugins communicate through SARA's CONTROL logic

amip_contracts.description: AMIP/AMIPI contract and protocol mapping for plugin management, as referenced in Excel and shunt_map_descriptor.updated.json.
amip_contracts.protocol_reference: See shunt_map_descriptor.updated.json: map_sets, authority_map, and allowed_profiles for contract enforcement and plugin routing.

sara_csharp_orchestrator.notes: This setup enables modular, safe, and incremental migration to Gen1, with always-on generative AI and plugin capability. SARA remains the middleware and fallback until all Gen1 pillars are stable.
